package.description: Generate and verify file checksums with confidence.

en-US.description: Generate and verify file checksums with confidence.
en-US.longDescription: PromptlyHash is an open-source Windows 11 desktop application for generating and checking MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 file hashes. Hashing happens locally; selected files are never uploaded.
en-US.name: PromptlyHash
